dataset.provenance: Project-authored synthetic scenario families, not real support records; not independently human-reviewed.
dataset.split_method: Topic-family grouping; all variants and scenarios in a family stay together.
dataset.augmentation: Two formatting variants per training base scenario; no validation/test augmentation.

audit.note: Lexical checks do not prove absence of semantic leakage or label ambiguity.

selection.selection_basis: validation macro-F1, then accepted coverage, then lower warm p95

fine_tuning.device_recording_note: Original runner hard-coded cpu in its report. SetFit auto-selected Apple MPS outside the sandbox; the MPS training warning and a same-environment device probe established mps:0. This metadata correction does not alter weights, selection, or scores.

limitations: Synthetic, unreviewed scenarios; not independent real support data.
Only 18 topic families and 90 base scenarios in the final test.
Training formatting variants do not add independent scenarios.
Measured model inference latency excludes queueing, IPC and end-to-end API processing.
Scores and acceptance thresholds are not production-calibrated.
standardized_latency_note: Measured all saved candidates on validation texts only using a common CPU and exported JSON classifier head. Does not reopen final-test labels or change model selection.
